parameter_matrix.note: Wider operating Vin window supports broader rail & battery chemistry headroom.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.

parameter_matrix.part_a_value: ESR-Sensitive · >=22 µF · See datasheet ESR curve
parameter_matrix.note: Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: CAUTION OUTPUT CAPACITANCE: Minimum Cout differs significantly (AMS1117-3.3: 22 µF p.4 vs NCP1117ST33T3G: 4.7 µF p.9); account for MLCC DC-bias derating.
CAUTION THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA differs by 44% (AMS1117-3.3: 90 °C/W p.2 vs NCP1117ST33T3G: 160 °C/W p.2); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
engineering_verdict: AMS1117-3.3 (Advanced Monolithic Systems, SOT-223-3) and NCP1117ST33T3G (onsemi, SOT-223-3) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required replacements: while the footprint is physically compatible, engineering review and passive/circuit adjustments are mandatory due to minimum output capacitance requirement differs >= 2.5x. Key datasheet deltas: Iq is 5000 µA (p.3) vs 6000 µA (p.4), max output current is 1000 mA (p.1) vs 1000 mA (p.3), recommended Vin,max is 15 V (p.2) vs 15 V (p.3), typical dropout is 1100 mV (p.3) vs 1070 mV (p.3), and ceramic capacitor stability is ESR-constrained vs ESR-constrained. Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.1), thermal margin (θJA 90 vs 160 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
